verses.arabicText: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.transliteration: Tabāraka alladhī biyadihi l-mul'ku wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīr
verses.translation: Blessed is the One in Whose Hands rests all authority. And He is Most Capable of everything

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
verses.transliteration: Alladhī khalaqa l-mawta wal-ḥayata liyabluwakum ayyukum aḥsanu ʿamalaw-wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ghafūr
verses.translation: ˹He is the One˺ Who created death and life in order to test which of you is best in deeds. And He is the Almighty, All-Forgiving

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِن تَفَـٰوُتٍ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ
verses.transliteration: Alladhī khalaqa sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqam-mā tarā fī khalqi r-raḥmāni min tafāwutin fa-ir'jiʿi l-baṣara hal tarā min fuṭūr
verses.translation: ˹He is the One˺ Who created seven heavens, one above the other. You will never see any imperfection in the creation of the Most Compassionate. So look again: do you see any flaws

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ
verses.transliteration: Thumma ir'jiʿi l-baṣara karratayni yanqalib ilayka l-baṣaru khāsi-aw-wahuwa ḥasīr
verses.translation: Then look again and again—your sight will return frustrated and weary

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَـٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad zayyannā s-samāa d-dun'yā bimaṣābīḥa wajaʿalnāhā rujūmal-lilshayāṭīni wa-aʿtadnā lahum ʿadhāba s-saʿīr
verses.translation: And indeed, We adorned the lowest heaven with ˹stars like˺ lamps, and made them ˹as missiles˺ for stoning ˹eavesdropping˺ devils, for whom We have also prepared the torment of the Blaze

verses.arabicText: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.transliteration: Walilladhīna kafarū birabbihim ʿadhābu jahannama wabi'sa l-maṣīr
verses.translation: Those who disbelieve in their Lord will suffer the punishment of Hell. What an evil destination

verses.arabicText: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
verses.transliteration: Idhā ul'qū fīhā samiʿū lahā shahīqaw-wahiya tafūr
verses.translation: When they are tossed into it, they will hear its roaring as it boils over

verses.arabicText: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ
verses.transliteration: Takādu tamayyazu mina l-ghayẓi kullamā ul'qiya fīhā fawjun sa-alahum khazanatuhā alam yatikum nadhīr
verses.translation: almost bursting in fury. Every time a group is cast into it, its keepers will ask them, “Did a warner not come to you?”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ كَبِيرٍ
verses.transliteration: Qālū balā qad jāanā nadhīrun fakadhabnā waqul'nā mā nazzala l-lahu min shayin in antum illā fī ḍalālin kabīr
verses.translation: They will reply, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we denied and said, ‘Allah has revealed nothing. You are extremely astray.’”

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.transliteration: Waqālū law kunnā nasmaʿu aw naʿqilu mā kunnā fī aṣḥābi s-saʿīr
verses.translation: And they will lament, “If only we had listened and reasoned, we would not be among the residents of the Blaze!”

verses.arabicText: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.transliteration: Fa-iʿ'tarafū bidhanbihim fasuḥ'qal-li-aṣḥābi s-saʿīr
verses.translation: And so they will confess their sins. So away with the residents of the Blaze

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
verses.transliteration: Inna alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratuw-wa-ajrun kabīr
verses.translation: Indeed, those in awe of their Lord without seeing Him will have forgiveness and a mighty reward

verses.arabicText: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.transliteration: Wa-asirrū qawlakum awi ij'harū bihi innahu ʿalīmun bidhāti ṣ-ṣudūr
verses.translation: Whether you speak secretly or openly—He surely knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart

verses.arabicText: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.transliteration: Alā yaʿlamu man khalaqa wahuwa l-laṭīfu l-khabīr
verses.translation: How could He not know His Own creation? For He ˹alone˺ is the Most Subtle, All-Aware

verses.arabicText: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
verses.transliteration: Huwa alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa dhalūlan fa-im'shū fī manākibihā wakulū mir-riz'qihi wa-ilayhi n-nushūr
verses.translation: He is the One Who smoothed out the earth for you, so move about in its regions and eat from His provisions. And to Him is the resurrection ˹of all˺

verses.arabicText: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
verses.transliteration: A-amintum man fī s-samāi ay-yakhsifa bikumu l-arḍa fa-idhā hiya tamūr
verses.translation: Do you feel secure that the One Who is in heaven will not cause the earth to swallow you up as it quakes violently

verses.arabicText: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
verses.transliteration: Am amintum man fī s-samāi ay-yur'sila ʿalaykum ḥāṣiban fasataʿlamūna kayfa nadhīr
verses.translation: Or do you feel secure that the One Who is in heaven will not unleash upon you a storm of stones. Only then would you know how ˹serious˺ My warning was

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad kadhaba alladhīna min qablihim fakayfa kāna nakīr
verses.translation: And certainly those before them denied ˹as well˺, then how severe was My response

verses.arabicText: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
verses.transliteration: Awalam yaraw ilā ṭ-ṭayri fawqahum ṣāffātiw-wayaqbiḍ'na mā yum'sikuhunna illā r-raḥmānu innahu bikulli shayin baṣīr
verses.translation: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading and folding their wings? None holds them up except the Most Compassionate. Indeed, He is All-Seeing of everything

verses.arabicText: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
verses.transliteration: Amman hādhā alladhī huwa jundul-lakum yanṣurukum min dūni r-raḥmāni ini l-kāfirūna illā fī ghurūr
verses.translation: Also, which ˹powerless˺ force will come to your help instead of the Most Compassionate? Indeed, the disbelievers are only ˹lost˺ in delusion

verses.arabicText: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ
verses.transliteration: Amman hādhā alladhī yarzuqukum in amsaka riz'qahu bal lajjū fī ʿutuwwiw-wanufūr
verses.translation: Or who is it that will provide for you if He withholds His provision? In fact, they persist in arrogance and aversion ˹to the truth˺

verses.arabicText: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Afamay-yamshī mukibban ʿalā wajhihi ahdā ammay-yamshī sawiyyan ʿalā ṣirāṭim-mus'taqīm
verses.translation: Who is ˹rightly˺ guided: the one who crawls facedown or the one who walks upright on the Straight Path

verses.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qul huwa alladhī ansha-akum wajaʿala lakumu s-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlam-mā tashkurūn
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “He is the One Who brought you into being and gave you hearing, sight, and intellect. ˹Yet˺ you hardly give any thanks.”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Qul huwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūn
verses.translation: ˹Also˺ say, “He is the One Who has dispersed you ˹all˺ over the earth, and to Him you will ˹all˺ be gathered.”

verses.arabicText: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīn
verses.translation: ˹Still˺ they ask ˹the believers˺, “When will this threat come to pass, if what you say is true?”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.transliteration: Qul innamā l-ʿil'mu ʿinda l-lahi wa-innamā anā nadhīrum-mubīn
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “That knowledge is with Allah alone, and I am only sent with a clear warning.”

verses.arabicText: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Falammā ra-awhu zul'fatan sīat wujūhu alladhīna kafarū waqīla hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi taddaʿūn
verses.translation: Then when they see the torment drawing near, the faces of the disbelievers will become gloomy, and it will be said ˹to them˺, “This is what you claimed would never come.”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Qul ara-aytum in ahlakaniya l-lahu wamam-maʿiya aw raḥimanā famay-yujīru l-kāfirīna min ʿadhābin alīm
verses.translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Consider this: whether Allah causes me and those with me to die or shows us mercy, who will save the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.transliteration: Qul huwa r-raḥmānu āmannā bihi waʿalayhi tawakkalnā fasataʿlamūna man huwa fī ḍalālim-mubīn
verses.translation: Say, “He is the Most Compassionate—in Him ˹alone˺ we believe, and in Him ˹alone˺ we trust. You will soon know who is clearly astray.”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
verses.transliteration: Qul ara-aytum in aṣbaḥa māukum ghawran famay-yatīkum bimāim-maʿīn
verses.translation: Say, “Consider this: if your water were to sink ˹into the earth˺, then who ˹else˺ could bring you flowing water?”
